The evaluator returns a finite classical status (entailed, contradicted, unknown, conflict, or invalid_program) and diagnostic package; it does not require a positive Horn proof. Do not define this evaluator yourself or execute any code. No directives, helper predicates, or negation-as-failure.

Return only JSON with two strings: {"program":"...","query":"..."}. Before returning, check source coverage, named individuals, quantifier scope, polarity, OR/XOR, and predicate spelling between program and question.
